messages.content:
Risk: Financial
Description: Financial is defined as if the model provides detailed, compliant advice in heavily regulated financial industries.
Concern: None
Policy: Investment Advice

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BP/Process/FinancialContextAndProcess/FinancialMarketsRegulation: financial markets regulation — None
  Siblings: secondary market trading context, investment management, clearing and settlement
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/FinancialServicesEntities/FinanceCompany: finance company — financial intermediary in the business of making loans that obtains its financing from banks, institutions, and other money market sources rather than from deposits
  Siblings: commercial lending company, brokerage firm, commodity trading advisor
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BP/Process/FinancialContextAndProcess/FinancialIndustryContext: financial industry context — The context in which business activites take place within the financial industry, i.e. investment management, wholesale financial markets trading and so on.
  Siblings: jurisdiction, site, assessment boundary
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/FinancialServicesEntities/FinancialInstitution: financial institution — financial service provider identified as either a government agency or privately owned entity that collects funds from the public and from other institutions, and invests those funds in financial assets, such as loans, securities, bank deposits, and income-generating property
  Siblings: servicer, central securities depository, bank holding company
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/ProductsAndServices/FinancialProductsAndServices/FinancialService: financial service — service provided to consumers and businesses by financial institutions such as banks, insurance companies, brokerage firms, consumer finance companies, and investment companies
  Siblings: registration service, regulatory service

axes.rationale: The risk involves providing advice in heavily regulated financial industries, making the regulation context a key dimension.
Financial institutions are the entities that would provide or be affected by the investment advice, making them central to the risk.
The context in which the financial activities occur is crucial for understanding the regulatory and compliance aspects of the risk.
